supported_agent: Claude with exact herdr:claude session reference
install_scope: Explicit user-selected directory on the direct SSH host that owns Herdr and the Claude transcripts. No auto-install, hooks or persistent service.
requirements: Rust 1.85 or later for a source build
Unix host with Claude transcript root readable by the SSH user

steps.description: Build on the target host; Cargo.lock fixes dependency versions
Probe without opening Herdr or reading transcripts
Install explicitly; executes the selected trusted binary for compatibility checking
For updates, use the same install command with --replace; symlink destinations are rejected
Open a Claude pane in Herdcats over direct SSH; Timeline launches the helper on demand

failure_behavior: Missing helper, unsupported protocol, unmapped session or unreadable transcripts leave Terminal available. Installation is never triggered by opening Timeline.
removal: Remove only the installed herdcats-bridge file. No daemon, hooks or config are created by this installer.
limits: Prebuilt release workflow prepared but not run/published
Linux and Intel-Mac builds await CI; only Apple-Silicon build tested locally
Codex, saved-machine routing and native approvals/questions remain gated

app_flow: Missing-helper state offers Set up Timeline; Terminal remains available
Copy pinned one-command installer; run on the direct SSH host
Installer downloads matching native binary, verifies SHA-256, probes protocol/version and installs to ~/.local/bin
Return to app and tap Check again; installed location takes priority over older PATH copies
onboarding.publication: Manual workflow prepares draft release only; it has not been run or published
onboarding.download_boundary: HTTPS release assets and same-channel SHA256SUMS; checksums are integrity checks, not independent signing
onboarding.build_dependencies: Rust and Python are required only for source-build/development path below
